name: aisquare
description: Portable memory for Codex: rlx's lifecycle hooks, run by rlx, or by uvx when rlx is not installed.

interface.longDescription: rlx's lifecycle hooks: each new session is handed what you saved, and your prompts are captured to your local rlx memory. They run rlx, or the pinned release through uvx, and stand down where $CODEX_HOME/hooks.json already runs rlx.
